title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across python/typescript/go; parity + v1.67.0 bumps
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Unifies auth, retry, and streaming behavior across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs; ergonomics improvements and version bumps to v1.67.0. No breaking changes; minor API ergonomics and bugfixes. See per-SDK notes in changelogs.
body: Summary: This PR unifies authentication, retry logic, and streaming ergonomics across the Python, TypeScript, and Go SDKs and bumps package versions to v1.67.0. Motivation: we have had small but accumulating behavioral differences between SDKs around auth token refresh, default retry/backoff behavior, and streaming cancellation/partial-read semantics. Those differences make cross-language integrations and our docs/tests brittle. This change: 1) centralizes the auth token refresh sequence and error surface (401->refresh->retry) so all SDKs expose the same errors and retry hooks; 2) normalizes retry policy defaults (idempotent vs non-idempotent ops, exponential backoff with jitter, max attempts configurable via SDK client opts); 3) refactors streaming APIs to provide a single ergonomic surface: an async iterator/stream event emitter for Python/TS and a channel-style reader for Go, with consistent semantics for early cancellation, partial frames, and final metadata; 4) adds parity fixes to request/response headers, telemetry tagging, and docs/examples; 5) bumps package versions to v1.67.0 for all three SDKs. Checklist: - [x] Design doc and cross-SDK proposal (ENG-2345) - [x] Implementations for Python/TS/Go - [x] Unit + integration tests added/updated - [x] E2E smoke against local redwood mock - [x] Changelog entries and release notes - [x] CI green (flaky streaming test stabilized) Commits summary: see commits list below. Testing: added unit tests for token refresh flow in all SDKs, integration tests for streaming cancellation and partial payloads, and updated existing retry/backoff test matrix. Ran the full CI matrix; one flaky streaming test failed initially due to ordering in the TS emitter, fixed by introducing a small sequencing guard in the emitter implementation and a deterministic test harness. Migration notes: consumers should not need to change code; streaming ergonomics improved but backwards-compatible shims preserved. For advanced users, new client options available: max_retry_attempts, retry_backoff_base_ms, streaming_partial_read_buffer. Impact: reduces cross-language surprises, simplifies troubleshooting and docs. Related: addresses ENG-2380 (streaming parity), SUP-4123 (customer reported auth/retry mismatch).

da7b6f0: sdk/go: channel reader ergonomics + retry policy impl
e1a8b2c: docs: update quickstarts and changelogs for v1.67.0
review_comments: Elliot Chen: Can you call out how we distinguish idempotent vs non-idempotent ops for retries? Also please ensure retry headers are preserved on retry attempts.

Maya Patel (author): We added an `is_idempotent` flag on operation descriptors used by the client; default behavior treats generate/embeddings as idempotent for safe retries. Headers are now copied through the retry wrapper; added test to assert header presence.
Priya Nair: The TS emitter ordering fix looks fine but the test was flaky on CI windows. Did you try throttling timers or using fake timers?

Maya Patel (author): I switched to a deterministic harness that stubs the scheduler (used fake timers in jest) and replaced a race-prone microtask sequence with an explicit queue drain in the emitter. Verified on macOS/Linux/Windows CI lanes.
Samir Gupta: The Go changes look good; please make sure we don't hold goroutines on canceled contexts. I think reader.go had a potential leak.
Maya Patel (author): Fixed the leak by ensuring the reader's internal goroutine exits on ctx.Done() and added a test that asserts no leaked goroutines using our test leak detector.
PR reviewer (CI): Initial CI failure: streaming.spec.ts ordering test failed on first run; subsequent run passed after fix; full matrix green.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash and merge on 2024-11-10 by Priya Nair. Squash message: unify sdks(auth/retries/streaming): parity fixes + v1.67.0 bumps\n\nDetailed: centralize auth refresh, standardize retry defaults, stabilize streaming emitter/reader, update tests and docs.
